correctness.rationale: All unordered leader pairs fall into seven orbit classes for every integer q>=3. Exact orthogonal decomposition of each positive-definite grounded Laplacian gives the stated rational cost table, verified symbolically. Five explicit positive differences exclude competitors, and the sole remaining difference has exactly one positive zero t=(q+2)/(q-2). The supplementary checker agrees with direct exact inverses in 224 instances and symbolic comparisons across the full domain. The variance scaling factor 1/2 is specified and does not affect minimizers.

originality.rationale: Compared precise objective and graph family with four accessible primary articles and actual semantic database queries. General inverse-grounded-Laplacian and joint-centrality theories supply ways to evaluate candidates but inspected statements do not imply a specified identity of optimal leaders or the threshold without new orbit reductions and strict comparisons. The closest published-finding corpus hit concerns zero forcing of a different barbell statistic, not leader variance. Historical completeness is not certified.
residual_risks: No exhaustive historical index or human novelty determination; possible equivalent specialized barbell leader-selection work outside inspected sources.
General published formulas can calculate these costs after case-specific work; distinctness here is the complete sharp all-parameter classification, not solvability in principle.

value.rationale: Complete parametric optimal-design classification for a natural two-community network joined by one adjustable bridge, including all leader-pair ties, bridge-weight threshold and the fixed-weight large-community transition. It distinguishes community gateway from peripheral placement and gives an exact benchmark for general leader selection schemes. This is more than a relabeling or fixed finite experiment; it resolves all q>=3 and real t>0.
